conventions.enum_column_key_matching_note: 管控表 v2 header cells embed the enum in the cell text (e.g. `狀態 Open/Monitoring/Closed`). An `enum_columns` key is the column-name prefix; match it against the start of the verbatim header string, not by equality.
conventions.tab_order_note: Keys appear in sheet order as read on 2026-09-02.
conventions.crosswalk: pm-status-crosswalk.json — every `enum_columns` value resolves there, via `vocabularies` first and `axes` second.

v1.note: 13 cols A-M; project-status-update read A1:M44 and mis-mapped K

專案管理總表.note: The only SOT for progress (五條鐵律 1). Gate rows overload two columns: Owner = 核准人, End = 核准日期. Priority has no enumerated set — only `High` observed.

Stakeholders & RACI.note: A stakeholder register only — there is no per-deliverable RACI grid here, despite the tab name and Playbook §4.

headers: 類別 時程/範疇/資源/技術/外部
Risk Register.note: A 阻礙 that cannot be cleared within one week must open a row here with Owner and 狀態 filled (會議記錄 header rule).

headers: 類別 人力/外包/工具/行銷/其他
Budget.note: Seeded with a 應急準備金 row at 10–15%.

headers: 狀態 已確認/未確認/已知背景/N.A.
Prerequisite Checklist.note: Its 狀態 column (已確認/未確認/已知背景/N.A.) is a confirmation vocabulary, not one of the five axes — see `unmapped_enums`. The seeded rows are EDM/CSRC-specific, not generic prerequisites.

headers: 影響 範疇/時程/預算/無
狀態 提案/核准/駁回
Change & Decision Log.note: A 決議 affecting 範疇／時程／預算 must land here; every Drop on tab 1 must leave a row here. 週報 RECENT DECISIONS reads from this tab.

所有檔案.note: 12 columns; the header strings were not captured in the 2026-09-02 live read, so none are asserted here rather than invented. Its status vocabulary is Active / Reference / Archive / 待清理 — see `unmapped_enums`.

Comms Plan.note: Cadence lives here, and it forks by engagement type: 內部團隊 weekly HTML 週報 · 客戶窗口 雙週 Email.

unmapped_enums.reason: A per-item confirmation state, not a lifecycle/health/risk/decision/closure value. Deliberately left off the five axes.
